guitar.notes: Contemporary country artist, plays acoustic guitar live but no documented iconic/signature model.

tone.target: clean country pop with light edge-of-breakup twang
tone.profile: clean country pop with light edge-of-breakup twang
tone.summary: A classic country/pop setup using a Fender-style clean amp (US Deluxe) paired with a bright 2x12 cab. The signal chain emphasizes compression for tightness, light OD for edge, and uses slapback delay and room reverb to achieve the desired space and twang.

rig.name: Morgan Wallen - Whiskey Glasses - Valeton GP-180

blocks.purpose: Clean up ambient noise and maintain signal clarity.
Tighten the low end and increase sustain for bright picking.
Provide subtle, natural breakup and twang without heavy crunch.
blocks.gap: The Blues OD is used to simulate the gentle grit of a worn tube amp rather than a specific pedal model.

alternatives.reason: Could also provide clean breakup, but Blues OD better matches the 'country pop' feel.

blocks.purpose: Simulate the bright, clean tone of a Fender-style 1x12 combo.
Provide a bright and focused sound suitable for country twang.
Enhance the bright picked notes and cut unnecessary low-end mud.
Achieve the classic country/pop 'slap' echo effect.
Add subtle space and depth without sounding washed out.

improvements.summary: Upgrade the cabinet IR to better match the Telecaster-style bright, focused country sound.

proposals.reason: A dedicated Tele/country cab will enhance the required twang and brightness.
